Hadith.3799 - Abu al-Sabbah al-Kinani and Sama'ah narrated from Abu Abdullah (as):
Imam (as) was asked about a man who carries goods for the people of the market, and they have set a price for him. They then say to him, "Sell it, and whatever profit you make above the price is yours."
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in that, but he should not sell it to them as a murabaha (profit-sharing agreement)."
